_assumptions_notes: Installed capacity: 3 existing machines + 1 new = 4 machines, each producing 500 units/hour, 20 hours/day, 300 days/year = 4*500*20*300 = 12,000,000 units/year. However, practical max is 60% of that due to changeovers and maintenance, so 7,200,000 units/year. Unit is a container. Selling price ₹12.5/unit based on industry average. Cost1: raw material (granules) ₹7.5/unit. Cost2: power & fuel ₹1.2/unit. Other variable: packaging, consumables ₹0.8/unit. Wages for 20 workers. Factory overheads include rent, insurance. Loan for new machine ₹60 lakhs, promoter contribution ₹15 lakhs. Depreciation rates as per IT Act. Working capital cycle: RM 15 days, FG 10 days, receivables 30 days, payables 45 days.
